title: Case 01: The Last Cup
subtitle: The Daily Bean, 8:15 PM. At 8:47 the lights fail. At 8:49 Daniel Rowan is dead. You have three loops to learn why.
loop_reset_text: The room snaps backward. Cups refill. Rain climbs from the pavement. Everyone forgets. You do not.

cafe.name: The Daily Bean
cafe.description: Warm light, cooling coffee, and too many people pretending not to watch Daniel Rowan. Every loop begins here.

office.name: Manager's Office
office.description: Paper, graphite and stale espresso. The breaker cabinet hums behind a staff photo.

alley.name: Rear Alley
alley.description: Rain turns the rear alley into a mirror. The back door latch catches fibers and secrets.

riverside.name: Riverside Walk
riverside.description: The riverside is quieter than the cafe. Omar comes here to review recordings away from Daniel.

maya.name: Maya Cole
dialogue: Daniel argued with everyone. I stayed behind the counter until the blackout.
You're asking about the order again? The ticket changed after Daniel complained.
The altered ticket proves the drink changed, but I did not touch his cup.

contradiction.result: Maya admits the drink order was changed after Daniel's complaint. Someone used that opportunity.

maya.asma_open: Watch Maya Cole. Do not decide too early. Ask one thing at a time and listen for what changes.
tells: Maya Cole answers quickly, but their eyes move toward the nearest exit.
This time Maya Cole reacts before you finish the question. They remember nothing, but the pattern changed.
Maya Cole tries to repeat the same wording. One detail is different.

omar.name: Omar Hale
dialogue: I left before the blackout. I was by the river, working.
Fine. I recorded Daniel. He threatened Lina with an audit.
I hid the recording because I did not want police taking my source material.

contradiction.result: The recording proves Omar concealed evidence, but it also places him away from the murder scene.

omar.asma_open: Watch Omar Hale. Do not decide too early. Ask one thing at a time and listen for what changes.
tells: Omar Hale answers quickly, but their eyes move toward the nearest exit.
This time Omar Hale reacts before you finish the question. They remember nothing, but the pattern changed.
Omar Hale tries to repeat the same wording. One detail is different.

lina.name: Lina Vale
dialogue: Daniel and I had business disagreements. I never went near the office.
The thread proves I used the back door, not that I harmed Daniel.
You cannot prove why I was near the office.

contradiction.result: The violet thread places Lina at the rear corridor, while the ledger gives her a reason to access the office. Her denial collapses.

lina.asma_open: Watch Lina Vale. Do not decide too early. Ask one thing at a time and listen for what changes.
tells: Lina Vale answers quickly, but their eyes move toward the nearest exit.
This time Lina Vale reacts before you finish the question. They remember nothing, but the pattern changed.
Lina Vale tries to repeat the same wording. One detail is different.

theo.name: Theo Marsh
dialogue: I was cleaning the grinder. I heard the breaker snap.
Yes, I borrowed the office key. I returned it before 8:40.
Maya saw me return it. I never had it during the blackout.

contradiction.result: The returned key clears Theo during the critical window.

theo.asma_open: Watch Theo Marsh. Do not decide too early. Ask one thing at a time and listen for what changes.
tells: Theo Marsh answers quickly, but their eyes move toward the nearest exit.
This time Theo Marsh reacts before you finish the question. They remember nothing, but the pattern changed.
Theo Marsh tries to repeat the same wording. One detail is different.

receipt.name: Altered Receipt
receipt.description: Daniel's usual black coffee was changed to an almond syrup drink at 8:31.

watch.name: Broken Watch
watch.description: The watch stopped at exactly 8:47, matching the blackout.

umbrella.name: Wet Umbrella
umbrella.description: Fresh rainwater and a violet fiber place someone in the rear alley.

thread.name: Violet Thread
thread.description: A violet thread is caught on the rear latch. Lina wears the same fabric.
thread.locked_hint: You have seen this place before, but not from the right angle yet.

voicemail.name: Recorded Argument
voicemail.description: Omar's recording catches Daniel telling Lina: 'Tomorrow the auditors see everything.'
voicemail.locked_hint: You have seen this place before, but not from the right angle yet.

breaker.name: Breaker Dust
breaker.description: Fresh graphite dust shows the breaker was deliberately bridged for a timed failure.
breaker.locked_hint: You have seen this place before, but not from the right angle yet.

ledger.name: Missing Ledger Page
ledger.description: A torn page documents transfers approved by Lina to a shell account.
ledger.locked_hint: A detail from the earlier loops tells you to return here later.

key.name: Spare Office Key
key.description: Theo returned the spare key before the blackout. His access does not match the murder window.
key.locked_hint: A detail from the earlier loops tells you to return here later.

timeline: 8:15 PM — You enter The Daily Bean.
8:23 PM — Omar begins a secret recording.
8:31 PM — Daniel's drink order is altered.
8:39 PM — Lina leaves her table for the rear corridor.
8:43 PM — Someone accesses the office breaker.
deduction_prompt: Who engineered Daniel Rowan's death and the 8:47 blackout?
truth: Lina altered Daniel's drink with an ingredient she knew could trigger his severe allergy, then arranged the blackout to retrieve the financial ledger during the panic.
partial: You identify Lina, but without enough evidence the case collapses under scrutiny.
wrong: Your accusation does not explain the altered drink, the blackout and the financial motive. The cafe rewinds.

loop_reveals.2: Look at me. We already know Altered Receipt does not fit. This time, watch Violet Thread before anyone knows we are suspicious.
loop_reveals.3: Something is repeating too precisely. We have Altered Receipt and Violet Thread. Now we find the detail nobody expected us to remember.
